page_title: LEC 0-4 INT | Lecce v Inter 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+1' Lecce take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
89' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

88' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
88' Tajon Buchanan (Inter) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
83' Tajon Buchanan (Inter) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
83' Shots on target – 1:7.
79' That's the end of the game for Ylber Ramadani, who is replaced by Medon Berisha (Lecce).
78' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Remi Oudin (Lecce) comes onto the pitch so that Pontus Almqvist can be given a rest.
76' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Inter) replacing Davide Frattesi.
76' Federico Dimarco comes off the pitch to be replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Inter).
73' None of the Inter players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
72' Lecce are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.

67' 0 - 4 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Stefan de Vrij (Inter), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the left post. The score changes to 0:4.
67' Federico Dimarco (Inter) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
66' Lameck Banda (Lecce) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
65' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) replaces Lautaro Martinez.
64' The game has come to an end for Henrikh Mkhitaryan. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Davy Klaassen (Inter).

64' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) receives a quality pass and unleashes a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just over the crossbar. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
63' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Niccolo Baroni had an easy-decision to make.
62' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
61' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
60' Wladimiro Falcone displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Lautaro Martinez (Inter) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.
57' It's time for a substitution. Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) comes on in place of Hamza Rafia.
57' The manager makes a subsitution with Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) coming on for Ahmed Touba.
57' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Nicola Sansone and he is replaced by Lameck Banda (Lecce).
56' 0 - 3 Fantastic team goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was set free in the area by Davide Frattesi and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
55' Substitution. Kristjan Asllani is replaced by Nicolo Barella (Inter).
54' 0 - 2 Davide Frattesi (Inter) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball into the top right corner.
50' 36:64 – the ratio of ball possession.
48' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
46' It looks like the ref can’t continue. He’s going to be replaced by Niccolo Baroni.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Lecce get a corner.
45+1' A pass from Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone and the move breaks down.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
42' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
40' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Doveri interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
38' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

36' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alexis Blin (Lecce), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
36' A quickly taken corner by Lecce.

35' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball is behind the touchline and Lecce will take a throw-in.
34' Emil Audero (Inter) sends a long ball forward to Denzel Dumfries, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
31' Wladimiro Falcone displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Alexis Sanchez (Inter) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
29' Carlos Augusto (Inter) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
23' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
17' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.

15' 0 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
13' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
9' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
6' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
